text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Periodic LDA for fixed He: separate Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, FFT grid and SCF. Includes independently converged DFTK plane-wave reference differences. Equations and problem definitions Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters. Local Kohn–Sham DFT E[n]=Ts[n]+∫vextn dr+EH[n]+Exc[n]+ENN [−12∇2+vext+vH+vxc]ϕi=εiϕi n(r)=∑ifi∣ϕi(r)∣2,∫n dr=N,vxc=δExcδn Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states. Formulations used by execution examples Common execution exampleApproximation or discretization Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF ψnk(r)=eik⋅runk(r) n(r)=2∑nkwkfnk∣ψnk(r)∣2 KS-LDA for a fixed 3D periodic He cell. BZ integration meshes differ from band paths; numerical convergence differs from physical-model accuracy. Exact and reference solutions Use stored independent DFTK, SCF, basis and k-point checks for a fixed small periodic He cell, limited to the pseudopotential and exchange-only LDA model. Finite-grid numerical referenceReference for the same problem Immutable periodic-helium energy and force reference audit F_{A\alpha}=-\frac{\partial E}{\partial R_{A\alpha}},\quad F^{\rm FD}_{A\alpha}=-\frac{E(R_{A\alpha}+\delta)-E(R_{A\alpha}-\delta)}{2\delta} Audit saved six-coordinate FD and Gaussian/PW comparisons; source versions, local-only He GTH, XC/units/cell/electron count fixed. No new k/basis/cutoff scans. Artificial He2,4electrons,5bohr cell. Stored geometry/localGTH version/LDA_X+VWN/Libxc/PySCF/DFTK versions remain fixed in saved-data/periodic-he-reference.json. Energy hartree; force hartree/bohr. Audit of stored6force components, energy differences and Gaussian/PW comparisons; zero new electronic solves. No new basis/k/cutoff scans, materials, metals or longMD claim. References and results of execution examples Common execution example Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF Separately executed DFTK plane-wave KS-LDA at Gamma and 2³ for the same model, with cutoff convergence saved. Different finite orbital bases are compared within a stated tolerance, without machine-precision claims. Separately executed DFTK plane-wave KS-LDA at Gamma and 2³ for the same model, with cutoff convergence saved. Different finite orbital bases are compared within a stated tolerance, without machine-precision claims. Inspect its input for differences from the figure’s conditions. Methods used by this problem’s execution examples Kohn–Sham density functional theory / DFT Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Electronic-structure basis sets Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Self-consistent field iteration / SCF Method-registry status: Educational example / related code LDA, GGA and hybrid functionals Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Pseudopotentials and PAW Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Periodic electronic structure and k-point sampling Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Code and execution Common execution example Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Fixed neutral two-electron closed-shell cell with integer occupations. Explicit Gamma-centered fractional k coordinates and equal weights. Independent DFTK uses identical GTH coefficients and Libxc functionals; no fitted energy shifts. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run.py --input inputs.json --output output python -m pytest -q test_periodic_dft.py Validation limits Invalid inputs, excessive overlap conditioning, SCF nonconvergence and missed tolerances fail explicitly. Small residuals alone do not establish k/basis convergence or physical-model accuracy.
